title: Company OKR Conduit: synchronized cutover + initiative alignment playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Historically our company-level OKRs and downstream initiative roadmaps diverge during quarter cutovers. This causes duplicated work, missed handoffs between GTM/Engineering/Product, and inconsistent success metrics across teams. Goal: Ship a repeatable playbook and tooling checklist (the 'Conduit') to ensure synchronized cutover windows that align initiative milestones to company OKRs with clear ownership, signals, rollback paths, and decision gates. Scope: company-level playbook, templated release/cutover checklist, cross-team communication protocol, minimal console/dashboard telemetry for alignment signals, and a lightweight gating rubric for go/no-go decisions. Out of scope: heavy automation or invoicing changes — this is first release as playbook + docs + pilot with 3 cross-functional initiatives.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook document published to Confluence with step-by-step cutover runbook and escalation paths
Three pilot initiatives complete the cutover using the playbook with retro and checklist sign-offs
Dashboards show a unified OKR-to-initiative mapping for at least 80% of company-level objectives during the cutover week
One automated alert/notification pattern implemented in Console to surface misaligned rolling milestones
Stakeholder sign-off from Engineering, Product, Design, GTM, and Finance on the gating rubric
